summary: The Stability Pool and Points source changes are merged, but merge alone does not settle user obligations or prove the current live state. Bram is checking production receipts and reconciling the audit findings. Release and public status updates will follow only after those facts are verified.
plainSummary: The team has finished several security fixes, but the full review is still open. We still need to check the system people are using and make sure earlier payments and rewards were handled correctly. I’ll do those checks next and update this board; you don’t need to do anything right now.
